purpose: W2-G foundation: extend the existing canonical Inventory authority with BatchGenealogy, CustodyPosition, TitleEvidence and InventoryRestriction facts, without changing Deal allocation or manufacturing independent verification.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: The existing Inventory authority is intentionally private-schema/raw-SQL. W2-G extends the existing `inventory` schema and introduces no public Prisma model.
The parallel-safe foundation tests its domain module by direct source import; barrel export is deferred to a mounted consumer slice.
Existing DECLARE/RESERVE/RELEASE command semantics remain unchanged. W2-G uses separate bounded evidence commands over the same canonical batches/positions.
W2-G does not add lifecycle quantity commands to the existing reservation contract; COMMIT/SHIP/ACCEPT/SOLD remain a later Deal-linked slice.
The first evidence foundation is unmounted and parallel-safe; API/UI exposure is later work.
W2-G does not consume or mutate Deal; Deal allocation remains W2-C.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
The generic forward-only checker discovers additive migrations dynamically and remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Extend the existing `inventory` schema, `inventory.batches`, `inventory.positions`, `inventory.reservations` and `pc_inventory_authority`; do not create InventoryV2 or another stock authority.

BatchGenealogy is append-only and represents typed parent→child transformations with exact quantities, pinned unit/profile identities and conservation checks. Genealogy cannot create physical quantity ex nihilo.
CustodyPosition and TitleEvidence are distinct facts. Custody records who physically controls stock; title/disposal-right evidence records the legal/evidentiary claim. Neither implies the other.

InventoryRestriction is an explicit versioned blocker/constraint fact with scope, reason, source evidence, effective interval and release/supersession evidence; restrictions cannot be removed by editing history.
Manual/document/ERP claims remain DECLARED evidence and never become independent verification merely because a custody/title/restriction row exists.

Every new fact pins tenant, organization, canonical batch/position identity, source type/reference, evidence version/hash and actor membership; cross-tenant or same-tenant outsiders cannot forge another organization's physical/legal facts.
Current user, membership and organization state are revalidated before mutation and replay. Revoked authority cannot return a prior receipt as current authority.
Evidence mutations are append-only commands with payload-bound idempotency, optimistic versioning, immutable event hash, audit and outbox in one transaction.

Evidence facts may reduce eligibility or availability only through a separately versioned policy/consumer; W2-G itself does not silently change reservation quantities, commit stock, transfer ownership, ship, accept or sell.
Existing W2-A conservation and W2-B bound-reservation guards stay effective. Genealogy/evidence commands cannot release, reuse or rewrite an Auction-bound reservation.
No browser field can select verified status, ownership truth, custody truth, legal finality or regulatory success. External receipts remain separate evidence producers.
Registration, Role Eligibility, W2-C Deal allocation, W2-D trust, Federal Accounting lock #4321, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests create and read BatchGenealogy, CustodyPosition, TitleEvidence and InventoryRestriction facts only for current tenant/organization authority.
Genealogy split/merge evidence conserves exact integer atoms across parent and child batches and rejects profile/unit/quantity mismatch, cycles and duplicate consumption.
Custody and title can intentionally disagree without one overwriting the other; the API/repository projection exposes the conflict honestly rather than inventing ownership.
Restriction supersession/release is append-only and requires current authority plus explicit evidence; direct UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE is denied.
Cross-tenant, same-tenant outsider and revoked-membership commands/replays fail closed.
Exact replay returns the original receipt; changed payload under the same idempotency key is rejected.
Forced audit/outbox/evidence failure leaves no partial genealogy/custody/title/restriction state or accepted receipt.
W2-A reservation quantities and W2-B Auction binding remain byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged; an evidence command cannot alter reservation status or quantity.
Forward migrations, zero public Prisma schema drift, backup/restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass while global independent gates remain unchanged.
remainingTerminalBoundary: COMMIT/SHIP/ACCEPT/SOLD and other quantity lifecycle transitions remain a later Deal-linked Inventory slice.
Progressive Trust consumption of custody/title/restriction evidence remains W2-D consumer integration work.
Mounted Inventory evidence API/UI and My Products → Batch → Lot → Deal user flow remain later UX work.
Verified REG.RU runtime and end-to-end double-sell acceptance remain required before terminal INVENTORY/DOUBLE_SELL_PROTECTION credit.
